title_options: GTA 6 Quiz: Only Real Fans Score 20/20 (Spoilers at End)
GTA 6: 50 Facts Nobody Tells You + Leaks & Spoilers
description:
Fifty GTA 6 facts, twenty quiz questions and four bonus ones, in six rounds: the numbers, where things are in Leonida (on Rockstar's official map), the funny stuff, easter eggs + GTA history, the leaks, and a story SPOILER round at the end (clearly marked: skip to "Final score" if you haven't finished the game). Keep score and tell us your number in the comments.

Every fact is from at least two reliable sources. Leaks are covered as reported news and labeled; nothing in this video comes from leaked builds.

thumbnail.note: No spoiler is ever shown on a thumbnail (A = score challenge, B = facts, C = quiz).

pinned_comment: What did you score out of 20? Drop the number 👇 (No spoilers in the replies, people are still playing!)

segments.headline: 50 FACTS
segments.text: Fifty GTA 6 facts, twenty questions, the leaks, and a spoiler round at the very end. Keep score: one point for every right answer.

segments.headline: 6 ROUNDS
segments.text: Six rounds. The numbers, the map, the funny stuff, easter eggs and GTA history, then the leaks. Round six is story spoilers, and I'll warn you before it starts.

segments.headline: ROUND 1
segments.text: Round one. The numbers.

segments.headline: QUESTION 1
segments.text: Question one. Take-Two counted GTA 6's pre-orders plus its first day. How much money was that?

chart.q: What did pre-orders + day one make?

segments.headline: $3.79 BILLION
segments.text: Three point seven nine billion dollars. Take-Two called it the biggest entertainment launch in history, but it includes months of pre-orders, so it isn't a clean day one number.

chart.q: What did pre-orders + day one make?

segments.headline: QUESTION 2
segments.text: Question two. GTA 6 scored ninety nine on Metacritic. Only one other game ever has. Which one?

chart.q: Which other game has a 99 on Metacritic?

segments.headline: OCARINA OF TIME
segments.text: Zelda, Ocarina of Time, from nineteen ninety eight. That also makes GTA 6 Rockstar's best reviewed game ever.

chart.q: Which other game has a 99 on Metacritic?

segments.headline: 80 HOURS
segments.text: Rockstar North's Rob Nelson says his own playthrough took about eighty hours, with some optional goals. GTA 5's story takes about thirty two. That's two and a half GTA 5s.

segments.headline: QUESTION 3
segments.text: Question three. At launch, three point three million people watched GTA 6 on Twitch at the same time. That broke a single game record. Whose record?

chart.q: Whose single-game Twitch record fell?

segments.headline: LEAGUE OF LEGENDS
segments.text: League of Legends, at three point one one million. And across Twitch, YouTube and Kick, people watched one hundred twenty five million hours of GTA 6 on day one alone.

chart.q: Whose single-game Twitch record fell?

segments.headline: 90 MILLION
segments.text: GTA 6's first trailer got ninety million YouTube views in twenty four hours. Guinness lists it as the most viewed non-music video in a day, ahead of MrBeast's fifty nine million.

segments.headline: 475 MILLION
segments.text: Trailer two did even better. Rockstar says four hundred seventy five million views across all platforms, in a single day.

chart.label: Trailer 2 views in 24 h, all platforms

segments.headline: 13 YEARS
segments.text: Rockstar used to be fast. Vice City came out one year after GTA 3. GTA 5 to GTA 6 took thirteen years and two months. Kids born the week GTA 5 launched are thirteen now.

segments.headline: CHEAPEST GTA
segments.text: Here's a surprise. After inflation, GTA 6 is the cheapest main GTA ever. GTA 3 cost fifty dollars in two thousand one. That's about ninety five dollars today.

segments.headline: QUESTION 4
segments.text: Question four. The standard edition is eighty dollars, the Ultimate is a hundred. Which one got more pre-orders?

chart.q: Which edition got more pre-orders?

segments.headline: ULTIMATE
segments.text: The Ultimate. Take-Two's boss Strauss Zelnick says the most hardcore fans pre-order first, and they buy the big one.

chart.q: Which edition got more pre-orders?

segments.headline: ROUND 2
segments.text: Round two. Where in Leonida. Every spot is on Rockstar's official map.

segments.headline: 2X GTA 5
segments.text: Rockstar describes Leonida as about twice the size of GTA 5's map. Fan measurements say anywhere from one point seven to two point five times, depending on how much water you count.

segments.headline: QUESTION 5
segments.text: Question five. Leonida has its own Bigfoot. What's it called?

chart.q: What is Leonida's Bigfoot called?

segments.headline: SKUNK APE
segments.text: The Skunk Ape.

chart.q: What is Leonida's Bigfoot called?

segments.headline: COTTONMOUTH LAKE
segments.text: Take the lakeside road at Cottonmouth Lake, south of Hamlet, and look for a deer carcass. Night works best, and it's there from Chapter One.

segments.headline: QUESTION 6
segments.text: Question six. There's a UFO in GTA 6, but only at a certain time. After what time?

chart.q: After what time does the UFO show up?

segments.headline: 2 AM
segments.text: After two AM.

chart.q: After what time does the UFO show up?

segments.headline: PORT GELLHORN
segments.text: Drive the country roads east of Port Gellhorn, alone, from Chapter Two. Look for an abandoned car with flashing lights. Not there? Try another night.

segments.headline: GULLET MARSH
segments.text: There's a giant crab too. Take a boat into Gullet Marsh, in Pelican Valley, and find the abandoned research outpost.

segments.headline: QUESTION 7
segments.text: Question seven. Turn the outpost's power back on and it asks for a password. What is it?

chart.q: Password for the giant crab outpost?

segments.headline: CLEAVES
segments.text: Cleaves. Type it in and meet the crab.

chart.q: Password for the giant crab outpost?

segments.headline: MILE ZERO
segments.text: Want a fighter jet? They're parked at Mile Zero Air Station, southeast of Key Lento, in the north half of the base. Getting in brings a huge wanted level.

segments.headline: FLIP FLOP HOUSE
segments.text: And the most searched spot of launch week: GTA 6's first shoe store is Flip Flop House, right off Sunbelt Highway in Key Lento. Guides count fourteen to seventeen shoe stores in all.

segments.headline: QUESTION 8
segments.text: Question eight. Key Lento is a play on a real Florida place. Which one?

chart.q: Key Lento is a play on which real place?

segments.headline: KEY LARGO
segments.text: Key Largo. The Leonida Keys are the Florida Keys, and up north, Lake Leonida sits right where Lake Okeechobee is.

chart.q: Key Lento is a play on which real place?

segments.headline: MOUNT KALAGA
segments.text: Leonida even has a mountain, Mount Kalaga, with a BASE jump at the top. Real Florida could never: its highest point, Britton Hill, is three hundred forty five feet tall.

segments.headline: GRASSRIVERS
segments.text: And Grassrivers is Leonida's Everglades: swamps, airboats and alligators, right where the real Everglades are.

segments.headline: HALFTIME
segments.text: That's eight questions. Six or more and you know your Leonida. Next, the funny stuff, then the leaks. And the spoilers are still coming.

segments.headline: ROUND 3
segments.text: Round three. The funny stuff. All of it is really in the game.

segments.headline: QUESTION 9
segments.text: Question nine. Swim far out to sea, away from land and boats. Who might come to rescue you?

chart.q: Stranded at sea, who may rescue you?
options: A dog on a jet ski

segments.headline: A DOG ON A JET SKI
segments.text: A dog. On a jet ski. Guides point to Gambit Bay, west of Key Lento, but it's random, so give it time.

chart.q: Stranded at sea, who may rescue you?
options: A dog on a jet ski

segments.headline: WEIRD AL
segments.text: Weird Al Yankovic is a DJ in GTA 6. He hosts Vice City FM, the non-stop eighties station, and he voices the Burger Shot ads. None of his own songs are in the game, though.

chart.text: Weird Al is a GTA 6 DJ
chart.sub: Vice City FM + Burger Shot ads

segments.headline: 30,000 CALORIES
segments.text: A fake fast food ad for Chacey's sells a thirty thousand calorie meat sandwich. And fans found its wide open prairie backdrop was filmed in Red Dead Redemption 2.

segments.headline: QUESTION 10
segments.text: Question ten. One classic activity didn't make it into GTA 6. Which one?

chart.q: Which activity did Rockstar cut?

segments.headline: DARTS
segments.text: Darts. And bowling. Rob Nelson told VGC that even Rockstar doesn't have unlimited time or money. Pool made the cut.

chart.q: Which activity did Rockstar cut?

segments.headline: A CARTOON PEANUT
segments.text: On day one, IShowSpeed was the most watched GTA 6 streamer. Number two was TheBurntPeanut, a VTuber. A cartoon peanut finished about six hundred thousand watch hours behind Speed.

segments.headline: NO DISC
segments.text: GTA 6's physical edition has no disc. The box holds a download code, because the install is up to two hundred twelve gigabytes. You buy a box, then download the game anyway.

chart.sub: A code for a 212 GB download

segments.headline: REAL BURGER SHOT
segments.text: Before launch, GTA's fake fast food became real. Two counters at the Miami Heat's arena turned into a Burger Shot and a Cluckin' Bell.

chart.ticker: Kaseya Center · home of the Miami Heat · Cluckin' Bell too

segments.headline: QUESTION 11
segments.text: Question eleven. Jason has a pet corn snake at his house. What's her name?

chart.q: What's Jason's pet snake called?

segments.headline: DOLORES
segments.text: Dolores. Guides say feeding her a mouse gives your Focus meter a small boost early on.

chart.q: What's Jason's pet snake called?

segments.headline: EASTER EGG
segments.text: GTA 6 has a literal Easter egg. Climb a tall radio mast in Bluegrass, north of Hamlet, for several minutes, and at the top there's a nest of painted eggs. Some guides put the tower in South Vice-Dale instead.

segments.headline: QUESTION 12
segments.text: Question twelve. Remember the Scooter Brothers meme? In GTA 6 it's a real app. What does it do?

chart.q: What does the Scooter Bros app do?

segments.headline: RETURNS YOUR IMPOUNDED
segments.text: It brings your impounded car back. Pay Scooter Bros a fee and they return it, no cops involved.

chart.q: What does the Scooter Bros app do?

segments.headline: QUESTION 13
segments.text: Question thirteen. In the first trailer, a shop sign refuses one kind of cash. Cash stored where?

chart.q: No more cash stored in...?

segments.headline: UNDERWEAR
segments.text: In underwear. Fans later found the same sign in the GTA Trilogy Definitive Edition.

chart.q: No more cash stored in...?

segments.headline: ROUND 4
segments.text: Round four. Easter eggs, and a lightning round on GTA history.

segments.headline: VICE CITY PORTAL
segments.text: GTA 6 hides a portal back to two thousand two's Vice City. Flip twelve switches in order, from the Badger radio tower in Key Lento to the Turtle Head power station, at night. The reward: Tommy Vercetti's shirt and bike.

segments.headline: QUESTION 14
segments.text: Question fourteen. GTA 6 hides a tribute to Paul Walker: a green tuner from the first Fast and Furious. Which car is it styled on?

chart.q: Paul Walker's car is styled on...?

segments.headline: MITSUBISHI ECLIPSE
segments.text: His Mitsubishi Eclipse. In GTA 6 it's the Maibatsu Penumbra, in a villa garage on Vespucci Island.

chart.q: Paul Walker's car is styled on...?

segments.headline: ARTHUR'S HAT
segments.text: Arthur Morgan's hat from Red Dead Redemption 2 is for sale at a yard sale in southern Port Gellhorn, from Chapter Two.

segments.headline: QUESTION 15
segments.text: Question fifteen. A photo in a twenty twenty one GTA remaster turned out to be a real house in GTA 6. Which remaster?

chart.q: Which 2021 remaster hid a GTA 6 house?

segments.headline: SAN ANDREAS DEFINITIVE
segments.text: San Andreas. The photo hung in its alien-themed bar. In GTA 6 the house is in Belville, and its garage holds notes from a man convinced he lives in a video game.

chart.q: Which 2021 remaster hid a GTA 6 house?

segments.headline: THE LEONIDA
segments.text: Even Red Dead 2 had a hint. Its files include an unused boat texture called The Leonida, from twenty eighteen. Fans only spotted it this year, and Rockstar never said if it was a tease.

chart.text: Red Dead 2 named a boat The Leonida

segments.headline: QUESTION 16
segments.text: Question sixteen. Jason's quiet style came from one movie star. Which one?

chart.q: Jason was inspired by which star?

segments.headline: STEVE MCQUEEN
segments.text: Steve McQueen, in the nineteen seventy two movie The Getaway. Rockstar's narrative lead says they also talked to Army veterans, who typically aren't running their mouths.

chart.q: Jason was inspired by which star?

segments.headline: LIGHTNING ROUND
segments.text: Lightning round. Four questions about the GTA games before this one.

segments.headline: QUESTION 17
segments.text: Question seventeen. What was GTA called before it was GTA?

chart.q: What was GTA called before GTA?

segments.headline: RACE'N'CHASE
segments.text: Race and Chase, at DMA Design in Scotland.

chart.q: What was GTA called before GTA?

segments.headline: QUESTION 18
segments.text: Question eighteen. Who voiced Tommy Vercetti?

chart.q: Who voiced Tommy Vercetti?

segments.headline: RAY LIOTTA
segments.text: Ray Liotta, from Goodfellas. And Vice City wasn't new then: it first appeared in the original GTA, in nineteen ninety seven.

chart.q: Who voiced Tommy Vercetti?

segments.headline: QUESTION 19
segments.text: Question nineteen. In GTA 4, the borough of Algonquin is based on which real place?

chart.q: GTA 4's Algonquin is based on...?

segments.headline: MANHATTAN
segments.text: Manhattan. Broker is Brooklyn, Dukes is Queens and Bohan is the Bronx.

chart.q: GTA 4's Algonquin is based on...?

segments.headline: QUESTION 20
segments.text: Question twenty. Before GTA 6, which GTA had the best Metacritic score?

chart.q: Top Metacritic GTA before GTA 6?

segments.headline: GTA 4
segments.text: GTA 4, with ninety eight. Then GTA 6 showed up with ninety nine.

chart.q: Top Metacritic GTA before GTA 6?

segments.headline: SCORE CHECK
segments.text: That's all twenty. Fifteen or more, you're a real Leonida local. Under ten, watch it again. Keep that number for the comments. Now, the leaks.

segments.headline: ROUND 5
segments.text: Round five. The leaks. First, what really happened. Then what's reportedly coming next.

segments.headline: SEPTEMBER 2022
segments.text: In September twenty twenty two, a hacker broke into Rockstar and posted around ninety clips of early, unfinished GTA 6 footage. Rockstar said it was extremely disappointed, and that work would continue as planned.

chart.text: 90 early clips leaked in one night
chart.ticker: Rockstar: extremely disappointed · work continues as planned

segments.headline: BONUS QUESTION
segments.text: Bonus question. The hacker was a British teenager tied to the Lapsus group. On bail in a hotel, what did he plug into the TV to keep hacking?

chart.q: What did the hacker plug into a hotel TV?

segments.headline: AN AMAZON FIRE STICK
segments.text: An Amazon Fire Stick, plus a phone. Rockstar told the court the hack cost it about five million dollars, and this month he pleaded guilty to all charges.

chart.q: What did the hacker plug into a hotel TV?

segments.headline: LEAKED EARLY
segments.text: Even trailer one leaked. It was set for December fifth, twenty twenty three, but a copy got out the night before, so Rockstar posted the real one about half a day early.

chart.sub: A copy leaked the night before

segments.headline: CYBERLEEK
segments.text: This year, a leaker calling itself Cyberleek posted clips from an unfinished build and tied them to a crypto meme coin. In October the coin missed its thirty million dollar goal, and the leaker said the leaks would stop.

chart.text: Cyberleek tied leaks to a meme coin
chart.ticker: Goal: $30M · missed · leaks stopped in October

segments.headline: BONUS QUESTION
segments.text: Bonus question. Back in twenty twenty two, one outlet reported GTA 6 would star a Latina woman, in a Bonnie and Clyde style story. Which outlet?

chart.q: Who reported a Latina GTA 6 lead in 2022?

segments.headline: BLOOMBERG
segments.text: Bloomberg. And that report held up: Lucia and Jason are the game's criminal couple.

chart.q: Who reported a Latina GTA 6 lead in 2022?

segments.headline: $400 BOX
segments.text: Dataminers also found an unannounced collector's box in the Rockstar Store's code. Rockstar later confirmed it: The Goodtime State, a four hundred dollar box of merch that doesn't even include the game.

segments.headline: REPORTEDLY NEXT
segments.text: Now what's reportedly next. According to a PlayStation dataminer, the launch files already mention online features, like joining a session. GTA 6 Online has no date yet.

chart.text: GTA 6 Online is already in the files
chart.ticker: According to a dataminer · no date announced

segments.headline: PC + DLC?
segments.text: A GamesBeat report says the PC version is reportedly aiming for early twenty twenty seven. And a longtime insider said back in twenty twenty two that story expansions are planned. Rockstar has announced none of it.

segments.headline: ROUND 6
segments.text: Last round. Story spoilers. If you haven't finished GTA 6, skip to the end now: the timestamp is in the description. Light ones first.

chart.label: SPOILERS
chart.sub: Story spoilers: skip if you haven't finished

segments.headline: AFTER THE CREDITS
segments.text: Finishing the story doesn't lock your save. After the credits, the game rewinds to the moment before the finale, and you keep playing.

chart.sub: You rewind to before the finale

segments.headline: 5 CHAPTERS
segments.text: The story runs in five chapters. Chapter two puts Lucia front and center, and free switching between her and Jason only opens partway through it.

segments.headline: MAJOR SPOILERS
segments.text: Now the big ones. Last chance to skip.

segments.headline: BONUS QUESTION
segments.text: Bonus question. The prologue reveals a secret Rockstar kept for years: Jason and Lucia have a baby son. What's his name?

chart.q: What's Jason and Lucia's son called?

segments.headline: TOMÁS
segments.text: Tomás. Lucia's arrest in the prologue separates her from him, and that raises the stakes for everything after.

chart.q: What's Jason and Lucia's son called?

segments.headline: NIKO IS BACK
segments.text: And in the final chapter, an older Niko Bellic, the star of GTA 4, shows up in two cutscenes. His original voice actor, Michael Hollick, is back, credited only as The Hitman.

segments.headline: ENDINGS
segments.text: GTA 6 has more than one ending, and your choices along the way decide which one you see. Kotaku says they play out in wildly different, sometimes surprising ways.

segments.headline: BONUS QUESTION
segments.text: Last bonus question. What is GTA 6's final mission called?

chart.q: What is GTA 6's final mission called?

segments.headline: THE END OF THE ROAD
segments.text: The End of the Road. It's the point of no return in chapter five, so make a separate save before you start it.

chart.q: What is GTA 6's final mission called?

segments.headline: YOUR SCORE?
segments.text: That's GTA 6 trivia: twenty questions, four bonus ones, the leaks and the spoilers. What did you score out of twenty? Tell me in the comments, and subscribe for more GTA 6.
